relation_kinds.translation: proposed translation correspondence; not a certified dictionary sense

editorial_review.scope: All 32 verses reread in both pinned texts.
notes: Gen 11:3: denominative brick-making verb and cognate object retained separately; intensifying burning construction preserved.
Gen 11:4: negative purpose expression and passive dispersion separated from French support pronoun and auxiliary.
Gen 11:6–7: negative impossibility construction and implicit reciprocal language reference distinguish grammatical expansion from lexical meaning.
Gen 11:9: Babel and the separate verb confuse remain distinct despite the name wordplay.
Gen 11:10–26: genealogical age, repeated year terms and compound numerals retain individual source identities.
Gen 11:30–31: possessive existence construction and the comitative expression are linked to the LSG rendering without changing the source.
editorial_review.limitations: Both passes performed by the same editor; no independent dictionary-sense verification; publication checks deferred.
